sources.title: HannStar Board International Holdings Limited Annual Report 2008
sources.locator: Chairman’s statement, p. 3; Business Review, p. 10
sources.note: Reports approximately 55 million notebook-PCB pieces shipped in 2008 and over 40% of the global notebook-PCB market, describing the group as the largest supplier.

sources.title: HannStar Board International Holdings Limited Annual Report 2010
sources.note: States notebook-PCB shipments exceeded 40% of global market share and that the group held a leading position. The metric is notebook PCB shipments, not all PC/NB products.

sources.title: 瀚宇博佈局高階應用 打造全球共享平台
sources.locator: Paragraph on product mix and first-quarter revenue
sources.note: Reports PC/NB boards at about 38% of overall revenue, attributed to the company, and says the proportion had declined versus prior years. This is company revenue mix, not global market share, and does not attribute the change to market maturity.

sources.title: 瀚宇博AI伺服器板市占達23%；800G交換器板已送樣
sources.effective_period: 2025 first three quarters; PC-board share statement reported as of 2025-11-04
sources.note: Reports the company’s global PC-board share at about 50%, and separately gives PC products as 36% of revenue. The report does not establish a current first-place ranking, define the market-share denominator, or link revenue-mix changes to market maturity.
